text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up: tonight's outage traced to cloud auth latency -> token refresh stampede -> model-registry queueing -> serving timeouts. We need concrete remediation owners, short-term mitigations, and a rotating review cadence.

lee: I'll take gateway mitigations. Short-term: cap auth retries to 2 on 5xx, add exponential backoff + jitter, and implement a fast-fail circuit after 6 consecutive token errors. I'll draft PR today; staging by Thu.

kai: I'll own client SDK throttling/token-bucket to limit refresh bursts from SDK instances. Default 1rps per replica, config override. PR by Fri.

anna: Model-registry action: fall back to last-known-good token on transient auth 5xx (with a safety TTL), add metrics: token_refresh_total, token_refresh_errors, token_refresh_latency_p95. I'll add dashboard panels and an alert: token_refresh_errors > 0.25% for 10m -> P1. Staging by next Tue.

devops-bot: Created INC-5533: "auth latency -> token churn mitigation". DR drill scheduled 2027-04-22 13:00 UTC. Owners: lee, kai, anna.

vendor-liaison: Opening support escalation with provider and requesting auth endpoint traces + latency buckets. Will post case # and timeline by EOD. Also will draft a one-page vendor playbook update for auth incidents.

marta: Action summary with owners & deadlines:
- A1 lee: gateway retry/circuit changes. PR -> staging Thu 2027-03-31, prod canary Mon 2027-04-05.
- A2 kai: SDK token-bucket + config. PR Fri 2027-04-01, rollout canary Tue 2027-04-06.
- A3 anna: registry cached-token fallback + metrics + dashboard. Staging Tue 2027-04-05, prod 2027-04-12.
- A4 vendor-liaison: provider logs & playbook update. Case # by EOD.
- A5 devops-bot: DR + runbook snippet. DR 2027-04-22.

lee: I'll add a CI scenario simulating 500ms auth latency to validate fallbacks.

kai: I'll include a client-side backoff policy too and add instructions in devex docs.

marta: We flagged this as a repeating pattern (4 incidents in 9 months). Proposal: 8-week "dependency resilience" rotations (30m/week) to review vendor behavior and verify playbook changes. Volunteers for rotations?

vendor-liaison: I'll take week 1 and consolidate notes with provider findings.

anna: ok. Please post short check-ins here (one-liners): e.g., "lee: PR merged", "kai: canary live", "anna: dashboard up", "vendor-liaison: case #PV-9001". We'll close thread after prod rollouts and DR pass. :white_check_mark:
